meta.name: Apex design tokens
meta.source: Design canvas 'Apex Fedora Mockups' (the owner's private canvas); local copy in .design/canvas/project/
conventions: Every value records where it comes from: `sources` lists artboard files in canvas/project/; 'majority (N artboards)' means the value is the one most artboards define.
Where artboards disagree, `value` is the majority value and `conflicts` lists the others. Nothing here resolves a conflict; see OPEN-QUESTIONS.md.
Sizes are logical pixels at the 1440x900 artboard scale. The target panel renders at scale 2 (2880x1800), so device px = 2 x logical px.
Colour roles are the CSS custom properties the artboards define on `.apx-l` (light) and `.apx-d` (dark). The accent is the `--accent` custom property set inline from the `accent` tweak.
The GDM greeter, lock screen, boot splash and disk unlock do not use these classes; their literal values are under `fixedScenes`.

--msg-card.description: Notification card inside the calendar panel

--file.description: Generic file thumbnail tile in Spotlight

--sel.description: Selected row in a list (Code, Terminal)

--row-h.description: Defined for shell menu rows (WifiMenu, Transients, Updates) but never used; hovered menu rows use --btn-h (Transients.dc.html:62)

--bar-solid.description: Top bar when not translucent (maximised window or setting off). Desktop.dc.html and the two ApexDesktop artboards disagree; neither is a majority.

--panel.description: Shell panel glass tint (Quick Settings, calendar, toast, Spotlight, switcher)

--panel-solid.description: Opaque shell surface (modal dialogs, popup menus)

--pill.description: Search pill in Overview and Launcher

--scrim.description: Tint over the blurred wallpaper in Overview and Launcher

--folder.description: Launcher folder tile fill (Launcher) / folder glyph fill (Tiling)

--term-bg.description: Terminal window background when drawn inside another artboard

--term-key.description: Key/label column in apexctl output and SPEC.md lines

--t-bg.description: Terminal app background (Terminal artboards) and overview thumbnail

--line.description: Current-line or grid line (Apex Code; Overview workspace grid)

--md-code.description: Markdown inline code in Text Editor (Desktop)

--grid.description: 16 px grid overlay on Apex Symbolic sheets

--key.description: Keyline overlay on Apex Symbolic sheets

--dockbg.description: Dock strip behind the Apex Code icon preview

accent.note: These are exactly the nine libadwaita / GNOME accent colours (org.gnome.desktop.interface accent-color), so the accent picker maps to stock GSettings with no new key.

--accent-strong.use: accent fills that carry white text (primary buttons) and accent text on light surfaces

conflicts: Overview.dc.html redefines --shadow smaller for window thumbnails: light `0 12px 32px rgba(20,30,60,.2),0 1px 4px rgba(20,30,60,.1)`, dark `0 12px 32px rgba(0,0,0,.45),0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.3)`. Probably intentional (thumbnails), but it is the same token name.

glass.description: Live blur behind shell surfaces. CSS `blur(N)` is a Gaussian sigma of N logical px; GNOME Shell's `Shell.BlurEffect` takes a radius in device px with sigma = radius / 2, so radius = 2 x N x scale (4 x N at scale 2). Saturation needs a patched Shell.BlurEffect (the canvas calls it patch 0003).
glass.sourceOfTable: SPEC.md section 2.6 'Glass', drawn as editor text in AltTab.dc.html (lines 184-209 of that SPEC). The table's 'Source html:NNN' column points at a single-file prototype that is not part of the canvas.

surfaces.drawnIn: WifiMenu, DateMenu, Screenshot, Transients, Spotlight (toast), AltTab (switcher), Launcher (folder)
surfaces.note: The window switcher, screenshot panel, banner and Launcher folder dialog use the same 30/180 glass, and the OSD too, but the table does not list them. The edge-tiling preview uses blur(20px) saturate(160%) (Tiling.dc.html:131), also not in the table.

surfaces.drawnIn: Overview.dc.html draws filter blur(40px) saturate(140%) on the wallpaper
Launcher.dc.html draws filter blur(40px) saturate(140%) on the wallpaper
Lock.dc.html and Main.dc.html (greeter, light wallpaper and .68 always)
Main.dc.html (backdrop-filter blur(20px)) and Lock.dc.html:74 (fieldStyle backdropFilter blur(20px))

standard.use: switches, progress, segmented indicators, width changes

motion.note: The canvas gives motion only as CSS transitions inside prototypes. GNOME Shell animations (overview, workspace, OSD) are not specified; stock timings apply unless the owner says otherwise.

icon.fill: none; solid sub-shapes use fill=currentColor stroke=none
conflicts: Every Apex Symbolic sheet draws at 1.75, but glyphs drawn inline on other artboards use strokes from 0.95 to 2.25 (28 locations, listed in handoff/apex-symbolic.md). Tiling.dc.html:89,98 (1.5, 1.6) are not on the 16 px grid at all.
73 of the 291 sheet glyphs cross the 1 px keyline by up to 0.38 px (none leaves the 16 x 16 canvas); see handoff/apex-symbolic.md.
icon.scope: Top bar, Quick Settings, sign-in, Settings and Files sidebars, header bars, screenshot tool. App icons are the Colloid icon theme ('App icons stay Colloid', Glyphs.dc.html).
icon.count: 291 entries on four sheets (78 + 74 + 64 + 75), 289 distinct names, 224 distinct drawings

boot.wordmark: 26px diamond (3px stroke, 5px radius, rotated 45 deg) + 'Apex' 34px/800, -0.5px tracking, 18px gap; horizontally centred in a 41px tall row whose top is y 408 (centre y 428.5)
boot.progress: 160 x 3px, radius 2px, track rgba(255,255,255,.14), fill #fff; top 489

diskUnlock.field: 250 x 38px, radius 19px, fill rgba(255,255,255,.18), ring inset 1px rgba(255,255,255,.25); error ring inset 2px #ff8a8a (BootUnlock.dc.html:84)

greeterAndLock.wallpaper: light default wallpaper, blur(30px) saturate(130%), scrim rgba(8,10,20,.68); lock in dark mode uses the dark wallpaper and .34
greeterAndLock.field: 38px tall, radius 19px, fill rgba(255,255,255,.18), ring inset 1px rgba(255,255,255,.25)
greeterAndLock.errorRing: inset 0 0 0 2px #ffcfcf on the light lock screen, #ff8a8a on the dark one (Lock.dc.html:74)
